title: Minimal Slide
description:
Minimal Slide is a sliding puzzle game rich of features and with puzzles for players of every skill level.

The game features over 100 levels, divided in three difficulties, using many different types of tiles from classic tetrominoes to more complex shapes.

Beating a level is not always the end of it: try to complete it with the least amount of moves to reach the star score. You'll need to come up with new strategies to succeed, uncovering the hidden depth of the game!

The first time you beat a level, you earn coins you can use to unlock colors, textures and more with which you can customize the game's appearance. If you're lucky, you can even win rare special sets with unique visuals and sounds for the tiles!

Can't decide how to customize the game? Use the randomizer to randomly change visuals and sounds. You can even choose to randomize any combination of them each time you start a level!

• Over 100 levels divided in three difficulties. 
• 50+ customize options. 
• Randomizer for the game's appearance. 
• Various statistics about beaten levels. 
• Original soundtrack and sound effects.
description_short: Minimal Slide is a sliding puzzle game where you have to strategically move tiles to reach the goal in as few moves as possible. Beat levels of increasing difficulty and unlock ways to customize how the game looks and sounds!
